Smed TBK1 (hereafter referred to as TBK1) is encoded by the transcript dd_Smed_v6_1972_0_1, which is expressed throughout the organism according to single-cell RNA-sequencing data ( Fincher et al., 2018 ; Plass et al., 2018 ). However, whole-mount fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) staining suggested an enriched expression in intestinal cell

y based on sequence homology or functional prediction ( Fig. 4A ).
